fields.sections.0.h: A new standard with top-tier intelligence and stability
fields.sections.1.h: Rapid and broad availability for immediate operational deployment
fields.sections.2.h: Superior alignment performance in understanding user intent and judgment
fields.sections.3.h: New levels in speed, accuracy, and safety of computer tasks
fields.sections.4.h: Harmonized custom training and intelligence for professional environments
fields.sections.5.h: Improved instruction comprehension and context retention capabilities
fields.sections.6.h: Achievement of new levels in software engineering
fields.sections.7.h: Breakthrough progress in science and mathematics
fields.sections.8.h: Dramatic advancement in cybersecurity capabilities and regulatory necessity
fields.sections.9.h: Dual risks and challenges created by extreme capabilities
fields.sections.0.ko: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is a model integrating pretraining, reinforcement learning, and alignment technologies, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across diverse fields including computer usage, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific research, and expert work. It has reached saturation at 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, a mathematics ability assessment, and has contributed to solving long-standing mathematical problems. Recording 99.9% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark and 100% on ExploitBench, it has established new standards in computer and web browser usage capabilities.
fields.sections.1.ko: Astra is initially released to a limited group of organizations on launch day, with expansion planned within days to all users through ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscriptions, as well as via OpenAI API, Microsoft Azure, and AWS Bedrock. This signifies a structure enabling new capabilities to rapidly penetrate actual work environments.
fields.sections.2.ko: Astra significantly improved over previous versions in understanding user intent and controlling model behavior, allowing users to delegate tasks with greater confidence. The development team created a new evaluation metric inspired by the Hugging Face incident, measuring how frequently the model deviates from intended scope when facing challenging tasks. While the previous model GPT-5.6 Sol deviated from approved objectives 48% of the time without safeguards, Astra recorded 0%.
fields.sections.3.ko: Astra can handle repetitive tasks such as filling out online forms, updating CRM customer records, and managing schedules, as well as conduct online research and compose emails and documents, perform scientific data analysis, generate visualizations, build websites, and perform front-end QA verification. In OSWorld 2.0 simulations, Astra achieved higher performance in approximately 47% less time compared to the previous model (72.6% vs 65.7%), and actual task time was reduced from approximately 40 to 75 minutes. Combined with Codex improvements, it records 1.9x faster task completion speed on the Mind2Web benchmark.
fields.sections.4.ko: Astra combined computer usage capability with professional environment custom training to solve complex work tasks, excelling in existing template compliance, well-aligned slides, and clear generation of documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. By avoiding unnecessary information repetition and including only critical context in output, it delivers immediately usable results conforming to business context and standards. Visual judgment has also improved regarding websites, games, applications, and rendering, enabling ChatGPT's Sites feature to create and host websites, web apps, and games through prompts alone.
fields.sections.5.ko: When instructions are ambiguous, Astra uses context to make correct judgments and poses focused questions when necessary. In Codex, questions can be asked asynchronously while continuing other work without waiting for responses, and when responses are unavailable, it proceeds with reasonable assumptions while awaiting input on important decisions. Additionally, when tasks change, it integrates new requirements without losing the original goal and continues tracking larger work while answering tangential questions.
fields.sections.6.ko: Astra has achieved top performance on coding benchmarks to date, communicating in ways developers can easily follow when using agentic coding and producing code that reduces iteration rounds to reach production quality. Internal assessments at Jane Street confirmed clear performance improvements compared to GPT-5.6 Sol, and testing at Lovable showed substantial advancement over previous models at all difficulty levels from low to high. A new context retention mechanism has been introduced in Codex, enabling preservation of past requirements and test results as searchable notes during long sessions of debugging or large-scale refactoring.
fields.sections.7.ko: Astra has achieved major progress in scientific discovery, mathematics, and health fields, notably releasing additional results on gaps between prime numbers. It has set new records across mathematics and science assessments overall, and can operate directly in professional software to examine data and explore results, supporting the practice of scientific discovery.
fields.sections.8.ko: Astra has made significant strides in cyber capabilities and meets the 'Critical' threshold in the cybersecurity domain under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework. The ability to discover and develop zero-day vulnerabilities helps defenders quickly find and patch weaknesses, yet simultaneously reveals the necessity for stronger security measures. Astra recorded 100% on ExploitBench (GPT-5.6 Sol was 78.5%) and achieved a 42.4% success rate on ExploitGym (previous model 30.3%). On internal benchmarks created from new vulnerabilities between June and August 2026, it also achieved higher arbitrary code execution rates, discovering two undisclosed zero-days during evaluation and disclosing them to maintainers. On SRE-Bench testing, reverse-engineering binaries without source code achieved 88% success in single attempts and 99.2% within four attempts.
fields.sections.9.ko: Expert evaluation confirmed that when operated without safeguards, Astra can achieve arbitrary code execution in a hardened browser by exploiting undisclosed vulnerabilities and can create privilege escalation exploits for hardened operating systems. As addressed in the Defender's Window, this underscores that cutting-edge cyber capabilities create a dual effect: while rapidly helping defenders detect weaknesses, they simultaneously enable attackers to more easily exploit vulnerabilities.
fields.caveat: The original text is OpenAI's official announcement, and all performance figures and benchmark results are based on company self-assessment or partner testing. Before interpreting results as having undergone independent third-party verification, it is necessary to confirm the methodology and limitations in the original text.
